<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>Study companions</title>

html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:242px;overflow:hidden;background:#bfb5a4}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:242px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color('#bfb5a4');
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.08;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const viewHeight=4.30;
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-viewHeight*240/242/2,viewHeight*240/242/2,viewHeight/2,-viewHeight/2,.1,40);
ref.position.set(0,5.25,9);
ref.lookAt(0,1.80,0);

let seed=321875;
function rand(){
  seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;
  return seed/4294967296;
}
const V=a=>new THREE.Vector3(...a);
function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.85,extra={}){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,...extra});
}
function noiseTexture(){
  const data=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
  for(let i=0;i<64*64;i++){
    const c=115+Math.floor(rand()*80);
    data[i*4]=data[i*4+1]=data[i*4+2]=c;
    data[i*4+3]=255;
  }
  const t=new THREE.DataTexture(data,64,64,THREE.RGBAFormat);
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  t.repeat.set(3,3);
  t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
  t.minFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
  t.needsUpdate=true;
  return t;
}
const nap=noiseTexture();
const yellow=new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
  color:'#ffb510',roughness:.96,bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.008,
  sheen:.28,sheenColor:new THREE.Color('#ffda58'),sheenRoughness:1
});
const cream=new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
  color:'#f1dfb8',roughness:1,bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.006,
  sheen:.24,sheenColor:new THREE.Color('#fff0d2'),sheenRoughness:1
});
const handMat=material('#5d584c',.95,{bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.005});
const creaseMat=material('#454135',1);
const socketMat=material('#c18d25',.96);
const eyeMat=material('#7e8077',.67);
const pupilMat=material('#131812',.32);
const glintMat=material('#d9ddd3',.3);
const mouthMat=material('#3e2d13',.95);
const lipMat=material('#ca8b18',1);
const paperMat=material('#f4eedf',.98);
const paperEdgeMat=material('#d5cbb0',1);
const graphiteMat=material('#403f35',.8);
const sphereGeometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28);

function mesh(parent,name,geometry,mat){
  const o=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,mat);
  o.name=name;
  o.castShadow=true;
  o.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(o);
  return o;
}
function ellipsoid(parent,name,pos,scale,mat){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,sphereGeometry,mat);
  m.position.set(...pos);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  return m;
}
function box(parent,name,pos,size,mat){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size),mat);
  m.position.set(...pos);
  return m;
}
function line(parent,name,points,radius,mat){
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(V));
  return mesh(parent,name,new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve,Math.max(12,points.length*8),radius,8,false),mat);
}

/* Outward strand normals keep the short nap soft instead of stippled. */
const fuzzMat=new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,roughness:1,side:THREE.FrontSide,
  sheen:.25,sheenColor:new THREE.Color('#ffe1a0'),sheenRoughness:1
});
function fuzz(surface,count,color,length=.014){
  const geo=surface.geometry;
  const p=geo.getAttribute('position'),n=geo.getAttribute('normal');
  const uv=geo.getAttribute('uv'),ix=geo.index;
  const triangles=ix?ix.count/3:p.count/3;
  const cumulative=new Float64Array(triangles);
  const a=new THREE.Vector3(),b=new THREE.Vector3(),c=new THREE.Vector3();
  const ab=new THREE.Vector3(),ac=new THREE.Vector3();
  let total=0;
  for(let j=0;j<triangles;j++){
    a.fromBufferAttribute(p,ix?ix.getX(j*3):j*3);
    b.fromBufferAttribute(p,ix?ix.getX(j*3+1):j*3+1);
    c.fromBufferAttribute(p,ix?ix.getX(j*3+2):j*3+2);
    total+=ab.subVectors(b,a).cross(ac.subVectors(c,a)).length()*.5;
    cumulative[j]=total;
  }
  const positions=[],normals=[],colors=[],parameters=[];
  const baseColor=new THREE.Color(color);
  const normal=new THREE.Vector3(),tmp=new THREE.Vector3(),tangent=new THREE.Vector3();
  for(let j=0;j<count;j++){
    const pick=rand()*total;
    let lo=0,hi=triangles-1;
    while(lo<hi){
      const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;
      if(cumulative[mid]<pick)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid;
    }
    const ids=[0,1,2].map(k=>ix?ix.getX(lo*3+k):lo*3+k);
    const u=Math.sqrt(rand()),v=rand(),weights=[1-u,u*(1-v),u*v];
    const pos=new THREE.Vector3();
    normal.set(0,0,0);
    let parameter=0;
    for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
      pos.addScaledVector(tmp.fromBufferAttribute(p,ids[k]),weights[k]);
      normal.addScaledVector(tmp.fromBufferAttribute(n,ids[k]),weights[k]);
      if(uv)parameter+=uv.getY(ids[k])*weights[k];
    }
    normal.normalize();
    tangent.set(rand()-.5,rand()-.5,rand()-.5).cross(normal).normalize();
    const width=.0008+rand()*.0011;
    const len=length*(.45+rand()*.75);
    const tip=pos.clone().addScaledVector(normal,len).addScaledVector(tangent,len*(rand()-.5)*.4);
    pos.addScaledVector(normal,.001);
    const vertices=[pos.clone().addScaledVector(tangent,-width),pos.clone().addScaledVector(tangent,width),tip];
    const shade=.98+rand()*.045;
    for(const q of vertices){
      positions.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      normals.push(normal.x,normal.y,normal.z);
      colors.push(baseColor.r*shade,baseColor.g*shade,baseColor.b*shade);
      parameters.push(parameter);
    }
  }
  const fg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  fg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  fg.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals,3));
  fg.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  const fm=new THREE.Mesh(fg,fuzzMat);
  fm.name='short-soft-fur';
  fm.castShadow=false;
  fm.receiveShadow=false;
  fm.userData.curveParameters=new Float32Array(parameters);
  surface.add(fm);
  return fm;
}
function furryEllipsoid(parent,name,pos,scale,mat,count=0,color='#ffb915'){
  const m=ellipsoid(parent,name,pos,scale,mat);
  if(count)fuzz(m,count,color,.017);
  return m;
}
function profileValue(rows,u,col){
  const q=u*(rows.length-1);
  const i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(q)),t=q-i;
  const p0=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)][col],p1=rows[i][col];
  const p2=rows[i+1][col],p3=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)][col];
  return .5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t*t+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t*t*t);
}
function torso(parent,rows){
  const pos=[],uv=[],indices=[];
  const rings=80,sides=64;
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
    const u=j/rings;
    const y=profileValue(rows,u,0);
    const rx=Math.max(.001,profileValue(rows,u,1)),rz=Math.max(.001,profileValue(rows,u,2));
    const cx=profileValue(rows,u,3),cz=profileValue(rows,u,4);
    for(let k=0;k<=sides;k++){
      const a=k/sides*Math.PI*2;
      pos.push(cx+Math.sin(a)*rx,y,cz+Math.cos(a)*rz);
      uv.push(k/sides,u);
    }
  }
  for(let j=0;j<rings;j++)for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
    const a=j*(sides+1)+k,b=a+sides+1;
    indices.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  g.setIndex(indices);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  const body=mesh(group(parent,'torso'),'continuous-pear-shaped-body',g,yellow);
  fuzz(body,7000,'#ffb915',.012);
  return body.parent;
}
function local(character,point){
  return V(point).sub(character.position).toArray();
}
function flowRecord(m,isFur=false){
  const p=m.geometry.getAttribute('position'),uv=m.geometry.getAttribute('uv');
  const w=new Float32Array(p.count),bow=new Float32Array(p.count);
  for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
    const u=isFur?m.userData.curveParameters[i]:uv.getY(i);
    w[i]=u*u*(3-2*u);
    bow[i]=4*u*(1-u);
  }
  m.frustumCulled=false;
  p.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  return {mesh:m,rest:new Float32Array(p.array),w,bow};
}
function arm(character,name,worldPoints,radii){
  const armGroup=group(character,name);
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(worldPoints.map(p=>V(local(character,p))));
  const segs=56,sides=24,frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(segs,false);
  const pos=[],uv=[],indices=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=segs;i++){
    const u=i/segs,at=curve.getPointAt(u);
    const ri=u*(radii.length-1),r0=Math.min(radii.length-2,Math.floor(ri)),f=ri-r0;
    const radius=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[r0],radii[r0+1],f);
    for(let k=0;k<=sides;k++){
      const theta=k/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const q=at.clone().addScaledVector(frames.normals[i],Math.cos(theta)*radius)
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i],Math.sin(theta)*radius);
      pos.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      uv.push(k/sides,u);
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<segs;i++)for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
    const a=i*(sides+1)+k,b=a+sides+1;
    indices.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=mesh(armGroup,'soft-yellow-arm',geometry,yellow);
  const fur=fuzz(m,1800,'#ffb915',.011);
  const shoulder=ellipsoid(armGroup,'rounded-shoulder',local(character,worldPoints[0]),[radii[0],radii[0],radii[0]],yellow);
  return {
    group:armGroup,surface:m,shoulder,shoulderBase:shoulder.position.clone(),
    records:[flowRecord(m),flowRecord(fur,true)],
    endpoint:worldPoints[worldPoints.length-1],character
  };
}
function poseArm(rig,start,end,bend){
  for(const record of rig.records){
    const attr=record.mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position');
    const p=attr.array,rest=record.rest,w=record.w,bow=record.bow;
    for(let i=0;i<w.length;i++){
      const a=1-w[i],b=w[i],c=bow[i],j=i*3;
      p[j]=rest[j]+start.x*a+end.x*b+bend.x*c;
      p[j+1]=rest[j+1]+start.y*a+end.y*b+bend.y*c;
      p[j+2]=rest[j+2]+start.z*a+end.z*b+bend.z*c;
    }
    attr.needsUpdate=true;
  }
  rig.surface.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  rig.shoulder.position.copy(rig.shoulderBase).add(start);
}
function handGroup(character,name){return group(character,name);}
function worldEllipsoid(character,parent,name,pos,scale,mat){
  return ellipsoid(parent,name,local(character,pos),scale,mat);
}
function finger(character,parent,name,points,r=.048){
  const pts=points.map(p=>local(character,p));
  const m=line(parent,name,pts,r,handMat);
  ellipsoid(parent,name+'-tip',pts[pts.length-1],[r,r,r],handMat);
  return m;
}

function eye(head,name,position,scale=1,angle=0){
  const g=group(head,name);
  g.position.set(...position);
  g.rotation.y=angle;
  g.scale.setScalar(scale);
  ellipsoid(g,'golden-eye-rim',[0,0,-.045],[.172,.186,.084],socketMat);
  ellipsoid(g,'warm-grey-eyeball',[0,0,.012],[.139,.157,.118],eyeMat);

  ellipsoid(pupil,'dark-rounded-pupil',[0,0,0],[.087,.107,.055],pupilMat);
  ellipsoid(pupil,'small-soft-catchlight',[-.025,.044,.047],[.016,.020,.009],glintMat);
  return {group:g,pupil};

function smile(head,name,points){

  line(mouth,'soft-lower-lip',points.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]-.025,p[2]-.007]),.012,lipMat);
  return mouth;
}

const boardData=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<64;x++){

function pageHeight(t,z,depth){
  return .023+.092*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)+.013*t+.012*Math.cos(z/depth*Math.PI*2);
}
function makePage(parent,name,side,width,depth,height,mat,top){
  const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[],nx=30,nz=18;
  for(let j=0;j<=nz;j++){
    const z=(j/nz-.5)*depth;
    for(let i=0;i<=nx;i++){
      const t=i/nx;
      pos.push(side*t*width,height+pageHeight(t,z,depth),z);
      uv.push(t,j/nz);
    }
  }
  for(let j=0;j<nz;j++)for(let i=0;i<nx;i++){
    const a=j*(nx+1)+i,b=a+nx+1;
    if(side>0)idx.push(a,b,a+1,a+1,b,b+1);
    else idx.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  const page=mesh(parent,name,g,mat);
  page.castShadow=false;
  page.receiveShadow=top;
  return page;
}
function book(name,position,angle,width,depth,coverColor,writing=false){
  const g=group(scene,name);
  g.position.set(...position);
  g.rotation.y=angle;
  box(g,'thin-book-cover',[0,-.005,0],[width*2+.08,.028,depth+.055],material(coverColor,.94));
  for(let layer=0;layer<6;layer++){
    const h=.008+layer*.008;
    const mat=layer===5?paperMat:(layer%2?paperEdgeMat:paperMat);
    makePage(g,'left-page-layer-'+layer,-1,width,depth,h,mat,layer===5);
    makePage(g,'right-page-layer-'+layer,1,width,depth,h,mat,layer===5);
  }
  const crease=line(g,'central-binding-crease',[[0,.070,-depth/2],[0,.083,0],[0,.070,depth/2]],.007,material('#baa984',1));
  crease.castShadow=false;
  if(writing){
    const pencilWriting=material('#c0b6a1',1);
    for(let row=0;row<6;row++){
      const z=-.36+row*.115,pts=[];
      for(let j=0;j<12;j++){
        const x=-width*.83+j*.047,zz=z+Math.sin(j*2.0+row)*.009;
        pts.push([x,.049+pageHeight(-x/width,zz,depth)+.003,zz]);
      }
      const stroke=line(g,'faint-pencil-writing-'+row,pts,.0022,pencilWriting);
      stroke.castShadow=false;
    }
  }
  return g;
}

function cylinderBetween(parent,name,a,b,radius,mat,segments=12){
  const av=V(a),bv=V(b),direction=bv.clone().sub(av);
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius,radius,direction.length(),segments),mat);
  m.position.copy(av).add(bv).multiplyScalar(.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),direction.normalize());
  return m;
}
function coneBetween(parent,name,a,b,radius,mat,segments=10){
  const av=V(a),bv=V(b),direction=bv.clone().sub(av);
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.ConeGeometry(radius,direction.length(),segments),mat);
  m.position.copy(av).add(bv).multiplyScalar(.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),direction.normalize());
  return m;
}

function wristRig(character,name,worldPivot,parts){
  const base=V(local(character,worldPivot));
  const g=group(character,name);
  g.position.copy(base);
  for(const part of parts){
    g.add(part);
    part.position.sub(base);
  }
  return {group:g,base,character};
}

function poseWrist(rig,x,y,z,rx=0,ry=0,rz=0){
  rig.group.position.copy(rig.base);
  rig.group.position.x+=x;
  rig.group.position.y+=y;
  rig.group.position.z+=z;
  rig.group.rotation.set(rx,ry,rz);
}
function wristEndpointDelta(rig,armRig){
  const rest=V(local(rig.character,armRig.endpoint));
  return rest.clone().sub(rig.base).multiply(rig.group.scale).applyEuler(rig.group.rotation)
    .add(rig.group.position).sub(rest);
}

const times=[0,200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400,1500];
const tracks={
  leftX:[0,-.015,-.030,-.110,-.165,-.180,-.182,-.180,0],
  leftLift:[0,.035,.070,.210,.290,.310,.315,.310,0],
  leftTurn:[.12,.15,.20,.62,.82,.90,.90,.90,.12],
  leftPitch:[0,-.025,-.045,-.15,-.32,-.38,-.38,-.38,0],
  expression:[0,0,.025,.80,1,1,1,1,0],
  gaze:[0,.02,.15,.72,1,1,1,1,0],
  writeX:[-.06,-.13,-.21,-.35,-.42,-.44,-.44,-.44,-.06],
  writeY:[0,.018,.045,.065,.090,.100,.105,.100,0],
  writeRoll:[0,.13,.26,.42,.50,.54,.54,.54,0],
  rubX:[0,-.13,-.30,-.20,-.24,-.30,-.19,-.25,0],
  rubY:[0,.040,-.070,.055,.025,0,.100,.025,0],
  rubRoll:[0,.035,-.045,.025,.005,-.025,.035,-.005,0],
  rightX:[0,-.130,-.145,-.145,-.150,-.160,-.160,-.160,0],
  rightY:[0,-.025,-.020,-.020,-.005,.025,.028,.025,0],
  rightTurn:[-.48,-.55,-.57,-.57,-.58,-.57,-.57,-.57,-.48],
  rightPitch:[0,.025,.020,.010,-.020,-.055,-.055,-.055,0],
  rightRoll:[.035,.045,.045,.040,.030,.020,.020,.020,.035]
};
const zero=new THREE.Vector3();

function render(t){
  const phase=Number.isFinite(t)?((t%1500)+1500)%1500:0;
  let index=0;
  while(index<times.length-2&&phase>=times[index+1])index++;
  let u=(phase-times[index])/(times[index+1]-times[index]);
  u=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const sample=name=>{
    const values=tracks[name];
    return values[index]+(values[index+1]-values[index])*u;
  };

  const lift=sample('leftLift'),rise=lift/.31;
  leftHead.position.set(sample('leftX'),2.48+lift,0);
  leftHead.rotation.set(sample('leftPitch'),sample('leftTurn'),0,'YXZ');
  leftTorso.position.set(-.015*rise,-.035*rise,0);
  leftTorso.rotation.set(0,0,.035*rise);
  leftTorso.scale.set(1+.015*rise,1+.075*rise,1);
  leftBelly.position.set(-.055*rise,.015*rise,0);
  leftBelly.rotation.set(0,0,.025*rise);
  leftBelly.scale.set(1+.025*rise,1+.14*rise,1);

  const rightLean=-sample('rightX')/.16;
  rightHead.position.set(-.53+sample('rightX'),2.555+sample('rightY'),.03);
  rightHead.rotation.set(sample('rightPitch'),sample('rightTurn'),sample('rightRoll'),'YXZ');
  rightTorso.position.set(-.020*rightLean,0,0);
  rightTorso.rotation.set(0,0,.026*rightLean);
  rightTorso.scale.set(1,1,1);
  rightBelly.position.set(-.020*rightLean,0,0);

  const expression=sample('expression');
  leftSmile.visible=expression<.99999;
  for(const child of leftSmile.children)child.material.opacity=1-expression;
  surprisedMouth.visible=expression>.00001;
  surprisedMouth.scale.set(1,.65+.35*expression,1);
  openingMat.opacity=expression;
  openingLipMat.opacity=expression;

  const gaze=sample('gaze');
  leftEyeA.pupil.position.set(-.010+.030*gaze,-.020+.009*gaze,.105);
  leftEyeB.pupil.position.set(-.010+.020*gaze,-.020+.008*gaze,.105);
  rightEyeA.pupil.position.set(-.010-.012*rightLean,-.020+.006*rise,.105);
  rightEyeB.pupil.position.set(-.010-.018*rightLean,-.020+.008*rise,.105);

  poseWrist(writingWrist,sample('writeX'),sample('writeY'),-.025*rise,0,0,sample('writeRoll'));
  poseWrist(restingWrist,-.025*rise,.035*rise,-.020*rise,0,0,.025*rise);
  poseWrist(farWrist,-.060*rise,.100*rise,-.015*rise,0,0,.020*rise);
  poseWrist(huggingWrist,sample('rubX'),sample('rubY'),0,0,0,sample('rubRoll'));

  poseArm(writingArm,
    new THREE.Vector3(-.080*rise,.130*rise,-.020*rise),
    wristEndpointDelta(writingWrist,writingArm),
    new THREE.Vector3(-.055*rise,.005*rise,0));
  poseArm(restingArm,
    new THREE.Vector3(-.050*rise,.120*rise,-.010*rise),
    wristEndpointDelta(restingWrist,restingArm),zero);
  poseArm(farArm,
    new THREE.Vector3(-.055*rightLean,-.005*rightLean,0),
    wristEndpointDelta(farWrist,farArm),
    new THREE.Vector3(-.012*rise,.020*rise,0));
  poseArm(huggingArm,
    new THREE.Vector3(-.055*rightLean,.008*rightLean,0),
    wristEndpointDelta(huggingWrist,huggingArm),
    new THREE.Vector3(-.025*rightLean,.005*rise,0));

  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
